title: lure complainants via Kushida
context: Before the second hearing, Class C students have motivation to avoid Kiyotaka; Kushida is acquainted with them and can contact them.
observed_actions: Asks Kushida to send misleading personally enticing messages to the three students; meets them at a selected site before Ichinose blocks their departure.
observed_result: All three students arrive and are engaged in a time-constrained confrontation.
epistemic_limits: Kushida is a collaborator, not necessarily the tactical planner. The ruse relies on opponents' assumptions and does not prove generic mind-reading or always-successful manipulation.
information_available: Only actor's plan and actually received messages/arrivals; no future outcomes guaranteed.
counterfactual_test: Change who sent invitations, opponent suspicions or arrival timing; the meeting may fail.
